answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the fable until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the river of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
